description: Verifies an agent's x402 payment flow against a free Base Sepolia testnet endpoint. Call with no arguments first to get back the payment-required challenge (price, network, payTo). Sign it with your x402 client, then call again passing paymentSignature as the encoded PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header value to get back a verified/failed receipt.

paymentSignature.description: Encoded PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header from a signed x402 payment payload. Omit to receive the payment-required challenge instead.

name: check_payment_flow
title: Check x402 payment flow
